description: We offer tiered relocation packages designed to give you the right level of support for your move to Spain. From essential legal guidance to fully managed relocation, each option is built for clarity, confidence, and peace of mind.

packages.description: Choose the level of support that fits your needs
packages.subDescription: Tailored relocation services to guide you every step of the way

tiers.name: Essential Guidance
tiers.description: Professional guidance for a compliant start
features: Visa and residency eligibility assessment and guidance
Documentation review and application preparation
Certified document translation by a Spanish government-accredited translator
Visa-compliant expat insurance coordination
Clear step-by-step relocation roadmap
Email support for application-related questions

tiers.name: Full Relocation Support
features: Everything in the Essential Guidance, Plus:
Full visa and residency application management
Coordination with Spanish attorneys and tax advisors
Tax orientation and residency overview
Introductions to trusted local real estate agents
Housing contract review support
Appointment scheduling for NIE
Translator support for key appointments when required
Pre-arrival and post-arrival planning support

tiers.name: End-to-End Relocation
features: Everything in the Essential Guidance & Full Relocation Support, Plus:
End-to-end relocation planning and management
Priority coordination with Spanish legal and tax professionals
Comprehensive tax planning and ongoing advisory setup
Full housing support including landlord communication, negotiation, and rental applications to secure local rates
Certified document translation and in-person translator accompaniment for appointments
Post-arrival appointment support and registrations
Ongoing support after arrival for renewals, updates, and compliance
Dedicated point of contact throughout your relocation

cta.header: Not sure where to start or which path makes the most sense for your situation?
cta.intro: Schedule a free 20-minute strategy call with our team. During the call we will:
points: Review your relocation goals and timeline
Clarify visa, legal, and tax considerations
Help you understand your next steps
Recommend the best support option for your needs
cta.footer: No obligation. Just clear, honest guidance from local Spanish experts.

list.title: What types of visas do you help with?
list.content: We assist with a range of Spanish visa types including the Digital Nomad Visa, Non-Lucrative Visa, and work permits. During your consultation, we'll determine which visa best fits your situation and goals.

list.title: How long does the relocation process typically take?
list.content: Timelines vary depending on the visa type and individual circumstances, but most clients can expect the process to take between 3 to 6 months from initial consultation to arrival in Spain. We'll give you a clear timeline during your strategy call.

list.title: Do I need to speak Spanish to relocate?
list.content: No, you don't need to speak Spanish. Our team handles all communication with Spanish authorities, landlords, and service providers on your behalf. We also provide translator support for key appointments when needed.

list.title: Can I upgrade my package after starting?
list.content: Yes, you can upgrade your package at any time. We'll credit what you've already paid toward the higher tier, so you only pay the difference. Many clients start with Essential Guidance and upgrade as their needs evolve.

list.title: What happens after my visa is approved?
list.content: Depending on your package, we continue supporting you with post-arrival tasks like NIE registration, local bank setup, housing coordination, and ongoing compliance. Our Full and End-to-End packages include comprehensive post-arrival support.
